description.en:
RemoveParty_Message with the preset RemoveParty_MessageEx(1, [_paramID], [_flg_st_reset], 0, 0, 21, 0, "sysmes-remove_party", _not_pt_lock). For each character, the sound effect sys_021 plays (CMND_SND_OPEN_SYS_SE(21)), the system message "sysmes-remove_party" is shown with the character's name filled in, then the character is removed; the next one waits until the sound has finished.
Despite its name, this preset passes a fade of 0, not -1: the BGM is stopped at once and started again at the end (AddParty's NoFadeBGM presets pass -1 and leave the BGM alone).
No shipped script calls it.
Parameter ID of the character to remove, e.g. "para_cp0010".
true to also delete the character's saved record, so they start over if they join again. The shipped calls pass false.
true to call RemovePartyCmnd(id, reset, false) instead of RemoveParty(id, reset); see RemoveParty for the difference.

examples.case: Removing a member without the BGM fade (not found in script_clean/; invented)
